flow-php/pg-query-ext.role: package API under test: the pg_query extension's pg_query_parse(), built with phpize against the source-built PHP. The package is a subtree split of flow-php/flow src/extension/pg-query-ext; its Makefile, README.md, composer.json and ext/ sources are byte-identical to the monorepo at the 0.48.0 tag, whose MIT LICENSE is pinned because the split has none

libpg_query.license: BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE); bundled PostgreSQL sources under the PostgreSQL License
libpg_query.role: underlying PostgreSQL raw parser linked statically into pg_query.so, at the version config.m4 pins (the C libpg_query path pins 18.1.0); LLVM line coverage and AFL++ instrumentation of gram.c, scan.c and parser.c

php.role: runtime (--disable-all CLI) that loads pg_query.so; not instrumented
